node.label: Partial anomalous pulmonary venous return
node.definition: A form of anomalous pulmonary venous return in which not all pulmonary veins drain abnormally. Partial anomalous pulmonary venous return frequently involves one or both of the veins from one lung.

diseases.label: neurodevelopmental disorder with coarse facies and mild distal skeletal abnormalities
